description:
Retire the server's private file-backed repository and executor setups.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration and an executor over a file-backed root. The server crate's tests duplicate them; `create_test_app` builds on `initialize_file_backed_test_repository`, and `repository_missing_its_index` builds a repository and then removes its index.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/server/src/lib.rs`: `repository_missing_its_index` (`:93`).
- `crates/server/src/routes.rs`: `test_executor` (`:1054`), `initialize_file_backed_test_repository` (`:1104`), `create_test_app_with_html_doc` (`:1699`), `create_app_with_raw_fixture` (`:2621`).
- `crates/server/tests/server_integration/graceful_shutdown_tests.rs`: `initialize_repository` (`:75`), `executor_for` (`:81`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No server test defines a function that creates a file-backed repository or opens a file-backed executor of its own; a scenario that damages a repository does so to one built by the shared constructor.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Server tests use the shared file-backed constructors
